# Customize Composer

Trim Image, File, Voice, Location, Contact defaults to Image, Order, File. Order is entirely host-owned.

## Vue Preview

<ComponentPreview name="Composer" />

## Resolution

Omitting actions uses defaults. The explicit list removes Voice and Location and inserts Order by order. Capabilities can filter as conversation policy changes.

## Four Platforms

### Vue

~~~vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { FlareComposer } from "@flare-im/vue-ui/components";
import { ImageOutline, FolderOpenOutline, ReceiptOutline } from "@vicons/ionicons5";
const draft = ref("");
const actions = [
  { id: "image", label: "Image", icon: ImageOutline, order: 0 },
  { id: "order", label: "Order", icon: ReceiptOutline, order: 1, intent: "open-order" },
  { id: "file", label: "File", icon: FolderOpenOutline, order: 2 },
];
const capabilities = { availableActionIds: ["image", "order", "file"] };
</script>

<template>
  <FlareComposer v-model="draft" :actions="actions" :capabilities="capabilities"
    @send="sendMessage" @build="handleComposerIntent" />
</template>
~~~

### Flutter

~~~dart
final actions = <FlareComposerAction>[
  const FlareComposerAction(id: 'image', label: 'Image', icon: 'image', order: 0),
  const FlareComposerAction(id: 'order', label: 'Order', icon: 'file', order: 1, intent: 'open-order'),
  const FlareComposerAction(id: 'file', label: 'File', icon: 'folder', order: 2),
];

FlareComposer(
  controller: controller, actions: actions,
  capabilities: const FlareComposerCapabilities(availableActionIds: {'image', 'order', 'file'}),
  onSend: sendMessage, onAction: handleComposerAction,
)
~~~

### Android Compose

~~~kotlin
val actions = listOf(
    FlareComposerAction("image", "Image", "image", order = 0),
    FlareComposerAction("order", "Order", "file", order = 1, intent = "open-order"),
    FlareComposerAction("file", "File", "folder", order = 2),
)

Composer(
    actions = actions,
    capabilities = FlareComposerCapabilities(setOf("image", "order", "file")),
    onSend = ::sendMessage, onAction = ::handleComposerAction,
)
~~~

### SwiftUI

~~~swift
let actions = [
    FlareComposerAction(id: "image", label: "Image", icon: "image", order: 0),
    FlareComposerAction(id: "order", label: "Order", icon: "file", order: 1, intent: "open-order"),
    FlareComposerAction(id: "file", label: "File", icon: "folder", order: 2),
]

ComposerView(text: $draft, onSend: sendMessage, actions: actions,
    capabilities: FlareComposerCapabilities(availableActionIDs: ["image", "order", "file"]),
    onAction: handleComposerAction)
~~~
